description: This Java class implements a JobExecutionListener for the Journal Entry Aggregation Job in the Fineract project. It manages job lifecycle events such as initialization before the job starts and cleanup or logging after the job completes, including handling success and failure scenarios.

classes.name: JournalEntryAggregationJobListener
classes.description: A Spring Batch JobExecutionListener that manages the lifecycle of the Journal Entry Aggregation job, including initialization, success/failure handling, and logging.

methods.name: beforeJob
methods.description: Initializes job context parameters before the job starts, setting date ranges based on provided parameters or defaults.

methods.name: initializeDates
methods.description: Sets the aggregated date range in the job execution context, handling first-time and subsequent runs.

methods.name: afterJob
methods.description: Handles cleanup and logging after job completion, including rollback on failure.

methods.name: logJobExecutionSummary
methods.description: Logs a summary of the job execution details such as date range, record count, start/end times, and duration.
